final_candidates.decision_summary: Gln529 lies at the rim of the m102.4 epitope near the receptor-binding face; an Arg substitution introduces a positive charge that can disrupt antibody contacts while leaving the core ephrin-B2/B3 interface intact. Retained from the initial pool after numbering verification.

Glycine at position 528 can locally reshape the surface loop adjacent to the m102.4 contact, weakening antibody binding. It is outside the core receptor-binding residues, so ephrin binding is expected to be largely preserved.

Charge reversal at a peripheral epitope-side lysine offers a distinct escape mechanism (electrostatic repulsion) without overlapping the ephrin-B2/B3 contact core. Chosen over E528A to diversify mutational sites within the Top-3.

stop_reason.detail: Self-iteration without external evidence is unlikely to improve the Top-3; the pool has stabilized after correcting a WT-residue error at position 530.

history.rationale: Position 529 sits adjacent to the receptor-binding face near the m102.4 paratope footprint; an Arg substitution can perturb antibody contacts with minimal disruption to the ephrin-B2/B3 interface.
Gln529 sits in the m102.4 epitope at the receptor-binding face rim; an R substitution can disrupt antibody contact while being adjacent to, but not part of, the core ephrin-B2 contact.
A charge-neutralizing Gly substitution on the rim of the epitope can reduce mAb binding while largely conserving the core receptor-binding geometry.
E528 is adjacent to Q529 in a surface loop; glycine may locally alter loop conformation to weaken m102.4 binding.
Adjacent to C-terminal contacts of the m102.4 epitope; mutation to a bulky charged residue can sterically hinder antibody approach with limited impact on ephrin binding.
Position 530 is closer to the receptor-binding core; the risk of impairing ephrin-B2/B3 binding is higher than at 528/529, so confidence is downweighted.
Charge reversal at this solvent-exposed position near the epitope periphery may weaken antibody electrostatic contacts while leaving the ephrin-binding pocket intact.
Charge reversal at a peripheral epitope-side lysine could reduce m102.4 affinity; kept as a mid-tier option.
A conservative change on the epitope edge that slightly alters local H-bonding seen by antibody, likely preserving receptor-binding capacity.
Conservative change with small predicted escape effect; retained but unlikely to enter Top-3.
Small polar-to-acidic switch on the binding-face periphery that can alter antibody recognition surface without abolishing ephrin-B2 contacts.
A potential N-linked glycosylation-adjacent position; adding a negative charge here is more likely to affect glycan/viability than antibody escape, and no strong rationale supports it.

rejection.reason: A potential N-linked glycosylation-adjacent position; adding a negative charge here is more likely to affect glycan/viability than antibody escape, and no strong rationale supports it.

history.rationale: Charge removal at a peripheral epitope-adjacent position may reduce mAb affinity with modest effect on receptor binding.
Removal of a side-chain hydroxyl near the antibody contact region could modestly reduce m102.4 binding while preserving folding and receptor binding.
Distant from the m102.4 contact surface and receptor interface; expected effect on antibody escape is negligible.

rejection.reason: Distant from the m102.4 contact surface and receptor interface; expected effect on antibody escape is negligible.

history.rationale: Charge reversal on a surface-exposed site on the G head could alter long-range electrostatics guiding m102.4 binding, with low risk to ephrin engagement.
Position 489 is not in the m102.4 epitope; charge reversal adds risk without clear escape benefit.

rejection.reason: Position 489 is not in the m102.4 epitope; charge reversal adds risk without clear escape benefit.

history.rationale: Peripheral polar-to-acidic substitution far from the core receptor-binding pocket; low-risk exploratory immune-escape mutation.
No plausible mechanism for m102.4 escape at this position; dropped to free pool space.

rejection.reason: No plausible mechanism for m102.4 escape at this position; dropped to free pool space.
